query: SELECT r.employee_id AS "employee_id!", r.roster_date AS "roster_date!", r.is_on_call AS "is_on_call?", COALESCE(sd.code, sd.name) AS "shift_code?" FROM duty_rosters r LEFT JOIN shift_definitions sd ON sd.id = r.shift_id AND sd.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id = $1 AND r.department_id = $2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.roster_date)::int = $3 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.roster_date)::int = $4 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
